definitions.full: H1897. hagah I. הָגָה verb moan, growl, utter, speak, muse (only poetry) (onomatopoetic; Late Hebrew הָגָה muse, speak, spell a word, so Aramaic הֲגָא ; muse , especially Ethpa`al; Arabic satirize, insult, scold , also spell (borrowed meaning)) — Qal Perf. 2masculine singular וְהָגִ֫יתָ consecutive Josh 1:8 ; 1 singular הָגִ֫יתִי Psa 143:5 , וְהָגִיתִי consecutive 77:13 ; Imperfect יֶהְגֶּה Job 27:4 8 t.; 3 feminine singular תֶּהְגֶּה Psa 35:28 2 t., אֶהְגֶּה 63:7 ; Isa 38:14 , יֶהְגּוּ Psa 2:1 + 2t., תֶּהְגּוּ Isa 16:7 ; נֶהְגֶּה֑ 59:11 ; Infinitive absolute הָגוֺ 59:11 ; — 1 of inarticulate sounds : a. growl , of lion growling over prey, followed by על Isa 31:4 . b. groan, moan , in distress (like dove), absolute, Isa 38:14 ; 59:11 ( נֶהְגֶּה הָגוֺ ); sigh for ( לְ ) in sorrow, mourning, moan for 16:7 (|| לְ יְיֵלִיל ), so also Jer 48:31 . 2 utter , followed by accusative of thing, Psa 38:13 ; subject לָשׁוֺן Job 27:4 (|| דִּבֶּר ) Psa 35:28 ; 71:24 ; Isa 59:3 ; subject מֶּה Psa 37:30 ; Prov 8:7 — compare also below Po. below; speak (absolute) Psa 115:7 ( בְּ instrumental) 3. a. (soliloquize) meditate, muse , with בְּ of thing, Josh 1:8 ; Psa 1:2 ; 63:7 ; 77:13 ; 143:5 ; with accusative Isa 33:18 , subject לֵב . b. imagine, devise , with accusative Psa 2:1 ; Prov 24:2 (subject לֵב ); with Infinitive 15:28 (subject id. ) Po. Infinitive absolute only דִּבְרֵישֶֿׁקֶר מִלֵּב וְהֹגוֺ הֹרוֺ Isa 59:13 a conceiving and an uttering, out of the heart, lying words (|| וְסָרָה עשֶׁק דַּבֵּר ); — on form compare Kö i. 555 ; but read rather וְהָגוֺ הָרוֺ Qal Infinitive absolute compare Di; Ba NB 77 retains ᵑ0 & explanation as Qal Infinitive passive Hiph`il Participle plural וְהַמַּהְגִּ֥ים הַמְּצַפְצְפִים Isa 8:19 those that make chirpings and mutterings , of necromancers and wizards.
